name: Name
summary: Marks a member as a name rather than an identifier, so that nothing keys on something several of which may exist and any of which may change.

roles.name: Name
roles.summary: What a thing is called. Figures 5.1 and 5.2 are the whole pattern: a name may be absent, and there may be several. Neither is true of an identifier, and marking the difference is worth doing because the mistake is invisible — a name used as a key works perfectly until the day two things share one or one thing is renamed, and by then everything that joined on it is wrong.
